basic_profile.bio: I’m a 28-year-old history enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, but in my free time, I volunteer with the local Cub Scouts and engage in discussions about monarchies and governance. I’m a night owl, often online during late evenings and weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy exploring both the cosmos and the latest indie music releases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in History and have a keen interest in political systems, particularly monarchies. I’m largely self-taught in graphic design, picking up skills through online courses and hands-on projects. My involvement with the Cub Scouts has enriched my leadership and organizational abilities.
